research_components.name: Sparse autoencoders for feature decomposition
research_components.description: Developing and scaling sparse autoencoder methods to decompose polysemantic neurons into interpretable monosemantic features, including analysis of dictionary size, feature geometry, and cross-layer composition.
research_components.explanation: PUB-R1-01 introduces the core SAE decomposition method; PUB-R1-03 studies how dictionary size affects feature quality; PUB-R1-11 characterises the geometric structure of overcomplete SAE dictionaries; PUB-R1-16 traces cross-layer feature composition using SAEs trained at every residual stream checkpoint.

research_components.name: Activation patching and causal tracing
research_components.description: Using activation patching, path patching, and causal tracing techniques to localise and attribute specific computations within transformer models, from factual recall to circuit-level mechanisms.
research_components.explanation: PUB-R1-05 introduces causal tracing for localising factual associations; PUB-R1-02 applies activation and path patching to identify the indirect object identification circuit; PUB-R1-12 extends activation patching methodology to 70B parameter models with a hierarchical protocol.

research_components.name: Circuit-level mechanistic analysis of transformer capabilities
research_components.description: Identifying and characterising minimal circuits — comprising attention heads and MLP layers — that implement specific algorithmic capabilities such as indirect object identification, in-context learning, and attention head function classification.

research_components.name: Feature steering and behavioural control
research_components.description: Developing and theoretically grounding methods that use activation differences or SAE-derived steering vectors to controllably modify language model behaviour at inference time, including studies of generalisation and robustness.
research_components.explanation: PUB-R1-04 demonstrates activation addition as a lightweight steering method; PUB-R1-08 evaluates the cross-distribution generalisation of SAE-derived steering vectors; PUB-R1-14 provides theoretical foundations for contrastive activation difference steering vectors.

research_components.name: Superposition, polysemanticity, and representational structure
research_components.description: Theoretically and empirically characterising the conditions under which transformers store multiple features per neuron via superposition, and analysing the residual stream's representational structure layer by layer.
research_components.explanation: PUB-R1-06 develops the theoretical account of superposition and polysemanticity; PUB-R1-13 uses SAE projections to track how information accumulates in the residual stream layer by layer.

research_components.name: Evaluation frameworks and safety applications for interpretability

research_components.explanation: PUB-R1-09 introduces automated proxy tasks for benchmarking SAE feature interpretability; PUB-R1-15 applies mechanistic methods to detect deceptive alignment and scope-insensitive ethical reasoning.
